title: Night-time warming at Uppsala since 1840
summary: Uppsala's daily minimum temperature, per season against 1850–1900: how large the warming is, how large the natural year-to-year spread is, and whether the signal has emerged from that noise; and what it does to frost.

concepts.label: Weather station
concepts.description: Uppsala, Sweden (GHCN-D SWE00139148, 59.86° N 17.63° E, 13 m): daily records since 1836 (minimum temperature since 1840).

facts.text: Uppsala's temperature series, started by Anders Celsius's successors, is among the longest instrumental records in Europe.

children.label: Daily minimum temperature
children.description: TMIN, the night's lowest screen temperature, °C (GHCN-D stores tenths).

children.label: Urban heat island
children.description: A growing town stores heat and warms its nights; part of a city station's trend is local.

concepts.label: Season
concepts.description: Meteorological seasons: winter DJF (December counted with the next year), spring MAM, summer JJA, autumn SON.

children.label: Pre-industrial baseline
children.description: 1850–1900, the IPCC AR6 reference period; its mean is the zero of every anomaly here.

facts.text: IPCC AR6 uses 1850–1900 as the approximation of pre-industrial temperature.

concepts.label: Warming signal
concepts.description: The change of a season's mean daily minimum, last 30 years minus 1850–1900, °C.

children.label: Natural variability
children.description: The year-to-year standard deviation σ of a season's mean in the baseline: the noise.

children.label: Signal-to-noise ratio
children.description: Warming / σ. Above about 2, a typical year lies outside the old climate's normal range.

children.label: Time of emergence
children.description: When a signal first stays above the noise; earliest where variability is small (summer, the tropics), not where warming is largest.

facts.text: Hawkins and Sutton (2012) showed the signal of warming emerges first in low-variability regions such as the tropics, though they warm less.

concepts.label: Frost
concepts.description: A night with the minimum below 0 °C.

children.label: Frost-free season
children.description: Days between the last spring and the first autumn frost: the growing season's frame.

concepts.label: GHCN-Daily
concepts.description: NOAA's Global Historical Climatology Network daily: >100,000 stations, quality-controlled, not homogenised. On AWS as the public bucket noaa-ghcn-pds (CSV and Parquet, by year and by station).

facts.text: The bucket is open for anonymous access and updated daily.
